$comment: Committed snapshots of real Scraper Studio payload shapes, one bucket per target id. These make the repo runnable with zero credentials (BUGLE_MODE=fixture). In live mode they are ignored and the c_* collectors are triggered instead.

pocketbase.headline: Realtime subscriptions no longer drop on token refresh

entries.text: Realtime clients kept their subscription across an auth token refresh instead of silently disconnecting.
Added `@request.body` access inside API rules for POST and PATCH.
Bumped the embedded SQLite build to 3.47.2.

pocketbase.headline: Collection schema fields moved to a typed registry

entries.text: `schema` on a collection is renamed to `fields`; the old key is read but no longer written. Run the shipped migration before upgrading a cluster.
The Go SDK's `models.Record.SetDataValue` is removed in favour of `Set`.
New `geoPoint` field type with radius filtering in list queries.
OAuth2 state cookie now sets SameSite=Lax so Safari completes the redirect.

pocketbase.headline: Backup restore stops holding a write lock

entries.text: Restoring a backup no longer blocks writes for the duration of the copy.
`pocketbase serve --http` accepts a unix socket path.

coolify.headline: Per-service resource limits land in the UI

entries.text: CPU and memory limits are configurable per service without editing the compose file.
Deployment queue shows a live position indicator for queued builds.
Fixed a race where two pushes to the same branch could deploy out of order.

coolify.headline: Traefik labels regenerated on every deploy

entries.text: Custom Traefik labels set through the UI are now regenerated on deploy; move hand-written labels into the new `proxy.labels` block or they will be dropped.
Wildcard certificates renew correctly when multiple domains share one resource.
Dropped support for Docker Engine below 24.0.
Scheduled Postgres backups can target any S3-compatible endpoint, including R2 and Backblaze.
Server onboarding no longer fails when the host has an IPv6-only interface.
Funnel report shows drop-off percentage per step and supports up to 10 steps.
Added a self-hosted licence check that stays fully offline.
Session counts no longer double when a visitor switches protocol mid-session.

umami.headline: Cloud free tier drops to 50k events

entries.text: Umami Cloud free tier reduced from 100k to 50k events per month; self-hosted is unaffected.
New `/api/send` batching endpoint accepts up to 50 events per request.
Fixed timezone offset in the hourly chart for UTC+05:30.
Hybrid keyword plus vector search is stable and no longer behind an experimental flag.
The `vectorStore` experimental feature toggle is removed; embedders are configured per index instead.
Task queue no longer stalls when an index is deleted while a document addition is enqueued.

meilisearch.headline: Snapshot import respects custom data paths

entries.text: `--import-snapshot` honours `--db-path` instead of writing to the default directory.
Reduced idle memory by roughly 18% on indexes above 1M documents.
`table.header` repeats across page breaks and accepts a `repeat` argument.
New `context` expressions can read the current page number.
`style()` is removed; use `context` instead. The compiler emits a migration hint for one release.
Fixed baseline drift when mixing CJK and Latin text in one paragraph.
Export targets PDF/A-2b for archival submissions.
Bibliography sorting is stable for entries sharing an author and year.
Certificate issuance backs off per issuer so a failing ACME server no longer delays the others.
`reverse_proxy` supports `lb_policy weighted_round_robin` with per-upstream weights.
HTTP/3 is enabled by default for all TLS-enabled sites.
The `experimental_http3` global option is removed and now errors at config load.
Minimum Go version raised to 1.24.
Embedded replicas accept writes locally and sync them through to the primary.
Branch databases can be created from a point-in-time restore.
Fixed a connection leak in the Rust client under high concurrency.

turso.headline: Free plan row-read quota cut to 500M

entries.text: Free plan monthly row reads reduced from 1B to 500M; existing databases keep the old quota until October.
Usage dashboard exposes per-database row-read counters over the API.
Schema migrations on a parent database now propagate to child branches atomically.
The DAP-based debugger is generally available for Rust, Go, Python and JavaScript.
Multibuffer edits can be staged per-hunk before committing.
Fixed a hang when a language server returned a 40MB semantic-tokens response.

zed.headline: Settings move to a layered resolution model

entries.text: Project settings now override user settings per-key rather than per-block; deeply nested `languages` overrides must be flattened.
Added `agent.model` so the inline assistant can differ from the panel.
Vim mode respects `scrolloff` when jumping to a search result.

zed.headline: Collab sessions survive a network flap

entries.text: Collaboration sessions reconnect without dropping unsaved buffers.
Reduced cold-start time by around 90ms on Linux.
